# Acme UI

A neutral kit over the package @acme/ui, for the proof of `harnessly design code`.

## Consuming

Namespace `Acme`; a board loads `tokens.css`, `components/bundle.css`, `components/bundle.js`; root `Root`.

- Root — The provider every page of the kit sits in.
- Stack — Lays its children out in a column with a gap from the spacing tokens.
- Text — A run of text in one of the kit's sizes and tones.
- Button — Starts an action on the page: submits, opens, creates.
- PrimaryButton — The one main action of a page, as a preset of Button.
- Card — A framed block for one record with its title.
